en-US.name: EveryList
en-US.summary: Add, remove, and check off items on your self-hosted EveryList lists.
en-US.description: A private skill for a self-hosted EveryList instance. Add items, mark them done, remove them, and hear (or, on a screen device, see) what's on a list.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask every list to add milk
Alexa, tell every list I got eggs
Alexa, ask every list what's on my list

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Requires account linking against a self-hosted EveryList instance fronted by Authentik — see alexa/README.md.
